name: mention
title: Mention
description: A comment textarea that watches for the @ symbol and opens a small list of teammates, narrowing as you keep typing. Picking a row drops that person's name into the sentence as a highlighted mention.
use: People write comments or messages where others must be addressed directly from a known team list.
avoid: It needs a fixed list of people and a textarea; for a plain free-form note a normal textarea is simpler.
a11y: No reduced-motion handling: the popover still fades and zooms in for users who ask for less motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered dark textarea with a small Leave a comment label above and dim placeholder text inside, set on black. Typing @ brings a small rounded popover of rows, each a white name with a grey email beside it; the inserted name in the text is a blue pill.
behaves: Typing @ opens the list near the field, and each further letter filters the rows to matching names. Choosing a row inserts that name into the sentence as a blue highlighted mention and closes the list.
customise: Compose a label, an input and a content list of items as children; style the mention tag through classes on the root, and swap the textarea through asChild.
weight: light: A textarea plus a small popover that only mounts while an @ token is active.
